errors.text_span: 蓝色、橙色和绿色，分别代表“绝对位置编码码”、“相对位置编码码”和“相对位置编码码”
errors.evidence: The legend indicates that blue represents "-", orange represents "绝对位置编码" (Absolute position encoding), and green represents "相对位置编码" (Relative position encoding). The description incorrectly maps blue to "绝对位置编码码" (Absolute position encoding) and orange to "相对位置编码码" (Relative position encoding).
